title: Application to Residence Permit (Study) Process Steps for Finland
notice: There is no Finnish Embassy in Dhaka — all applications are submitted online via enterfinland.fi and biometrics at VFS Global Dhaka. Processing: 1–3 months.

processSteps.label: University Application : via studyinfo.fi (Opintopolku) — deadline typically Jan 20 for Autumn
bullets: Application is free — no application fee for public universities
Select up to 6 programs ranked by priority

processSteps.label: Offer / Admission Letter
bullets: Many universities offer merit-based tuition waivers — check your university's scholarship page

processSteps.label: Arrange Proof of Funds : €6,720/year — €560/month
bullets: Required by Migri as proof of living funds
Shown via bank statement or scholarship/stipend letter

processSteps.label: Arrange Accommodation : Student housing or rental confirmation
bullets: Apply to HOAS (Helsinki), TOAS (Tampere), or TYS (Turku) immediately after admission
Student housing: €300–550/month; private apartment: €600–1,000/month in Helsinki

processSteps.label: Migri Residence Permit Application (online) : 470 EUR
bullets: Upload admission letter, proof of funds, passport scan, accommodation proof

processSteps.label: VFS Global Dhaka Biometrics Appointment
bullets: Bring original passport, Migri case reference, and photo

costSteps.label: VFS Global Dhaka Service Fee : check vfsglobal.com for current rate
Tuition Fee : 8,000–20,000 EUR/year — waiver often available

contacts.name: Finnish Embassy (Nearest: New Delhi)
